title: How this course is most affordable?
text: Our Mentor 'Akhil Jain' is not running this program in partnership with any company, we are reaching directly to aspiring SDET's. Due to this we have more cushion & control on things & can take necessary steps for uplifting our QA/SDET community. Other companies are charging Rs 3,00,000 for Full-Stack SDET course & Rs 1,00,000 for SDET Program. Our pricing for SDET Program is Rs 4,999 which covers 20+ In-depth modules.
text2: We would encourage you to do your reasearch & compare the course curriculum, depth of topics, course duration & benefits we are providing with other vendors & once satisfied only then Enrol.
